items.title: I was going to write about Moussa Cisse on Patreon after there was a report of potential Hawks interest if he got waived.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
I was going to write about Moussa Cisse on Patreon after there was a report of potential Hawks interest if he got waived.

But I checked with a source and the sentiment was, and I quote...

"It would be bonkers if Dallas waived Cisse to keep Powell, so it won't matter."

quote.author: Shams Charania Tweets
quote.text: The Dallas Mavericks are waiving veteran center Dwight Powell, sources tell ESPN.
